    LARRY AND DONNA MARTIN’S RESPONSE TO ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY
      COMPANY, LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION SERVICES CORPORATION’S
      OBJECTIONS TO, AND MOTIONS TO STRIKE INTERVENOR TESTIMONY

         Larry and Donna Martin (collectively, the Martins) file this Response to Oncor Electric

  Delivery Company LLC (Oncor) and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation’s (LCRA)

  (collectively, the Applicants) Objections to, and Motions to Strike, Intervenor Testimony (AIS

  Item No. 4726), and would respectfully show as follows:


         Oncor and LCRA object on the basis of hearsay to three attachments to Mr. Martin’s

  direct testimony. The three attachments are letters from state representatives and senators to the

  Commissioners of the Public Utility Commission. The letters are not being offered for the truth

  of the matters asserted in the letters and are, therefore not hearsay under TRE 801. Additionally,

  they fall within the public record exception to the hearsay rule under TRE 803(8).
